title: PodcastPlayerView
description: Create AggregatorApp/Podcasts/PodcastPlayerView.swift. Accept episode: PodcastEpisode and credentialsStore: CredentialsStore; initialise AudioPlayerViewModel via State(wrappedValue:) in a custom init so the player is ready before body runs. Show ContentUnavailableView on viewModel.playerError. Otherwise show ScrollView > VStack(spacing:24) with horizontal ReaderLayout.hPadding containing: (1) centred calendarBadge from episode.date; (2) 'Daily Podcast' title2.bold centred; (3) date/meta caption; (4) optional ParagraphText for episodeTheme when non-nil; (5) Slider scrubber with isSeeking coordination per spec; (6) HStack time labels; (7) 64pt play/pause button with accessibility label; (8) 1×/1.5×/2× segmented speed picker. Include file-scope formatTime helper. navigationTitle 'Episode' with .inline display mode.
acceptance_criteria: Slider set closure sets isSeeking=true; onEditingChanged(false) calls seek(to:) and resets isSeeking=false
Play/pause button toggles isPlaying; accessibility label matches current state
Speed picker Binding calls setSpeed(_:) on change
